title: A fix already merged by another change cannot be closed
what: When a fix item's problem was already fixed on master by an earlier change (its test exists on master and failed before the fixing commit), `relay queue done` closes it naming that commit and test, without a branch of its own and without the owner; the refusal for a fix with --evidence names this form.
why: 24 Oct: the-bench-never-starts-a-worker-so-it-measures-n was fixed on master that morning (3b28fbf, 436ce08, tests/test_bench_worker.py; bench report ~/.relay/bench/2026-10-24T07-33-20Z/report.md meets every pass case), but the item stayed open; a change cycle then spent about 34 minutes and 123k tokens on it and stopped: the check cannot mark Q1 MET on a branch with no code, --evidence refuses fix items, and only a drop with the owner's words ends it. Repeats whenever a change fixes a queue item it did not take. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: `relay queue done the-bench-never-starts-a-worker-so-it-measures-n --evidence 3b28fbf` is refused (a fix needs --test), and a branch without code cannot get Q1 MET.
pass_cases: The same item closes with the fixing commit and tests/test_bench_worker.py named, after relay checks that the test exists at master and fails at the fixing commit's parent.
A fix whose named test passes at the parent of the named commit is refused (the commit did not fix it).
where: lib/relay_queue.py (done, close_refusal), bin/relay queue help, rules/queue.md
